notes.title: Update to item drops
notes.content:
The item system isnt where id hoped it would be, and i cant stack items, or just make the vip passes rare, and steam support hasnt got back to me in nearly 3 months.

So i closed the ticked, removed drops by default (theres still an option to re enable it in settings)

But if you re enable it, its only going to drop 1 - 2 items a day after a buffer window now

So hopefully the item spam isnt as oppressive now.

If anyone has items they dont want, i dont think theres any way for me to delete them, but if you send me a trade request i think i can take them off your hands?

I dunno if theres limits to that

If there is, and it continues to be a problem ill try to find some other way to clean up the mess i caused.

I apologise again.

Im a little busy in the near future

But Ill hopefully be back to adding more pictures soon.

I might have a collab with denpafish lined up at some point for something special, but its not etched in stone right now

(Check their streams out here, theyre very fun and weird and chaotic) ːsteamhappyː
https://www.twitch.tv/denpafish

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992455/bf1bebfc6527f3802062e7aff8d629a1a2f59a41.jpg[/img]

Hopefully the tracks can line up and the future of pixel paint can be a little brighter and less messy

Thanks for your time and patience, and sorry again ːlunar2019piginablanketː

notes.title: LAUNCH DAY UPDATE!
notes.content:
Its finally release day!  (or it will be several hours from now!) ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Its been a long road to get here, but im excited, hopefully everything goes well 

Thank you to everyone who helped me up to this point ːlunar2019piginablanketː

--------

Anyway, ill stop blabbing

Updates!

(mostly backend but the most front facing change is q and e now ignores completed colors when cycling)

New pack!

Its called Three!  
Its a weirder pack then usual because I wanted it to feel special for release! 
12 new pictures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992455/2abfb22484997a3efed8457093d9e8073a7aa266.png[/img]

--------

I will be trying to release a new pack every day for a week to celebrate launch week since I have some free time atm!

If there are any problems, or anyone has any suggestions, pls contact me through any means you find comfortable ːlunar2019piginablanketː

[b]If any of you could spare a review once we go live, it would help a ton! 

If it can get over 10 reviews, it will be a lot more visible on steam! [/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992455/fe72d533de1a374f115d3d96ed9555f99b93337f.png[/img]

Thanks again to everyone! 

And hope the new people have fun! ːsteamhappyː
